links.comparator_used: Initial prompt before prompt engineering (Llama3-8b baseline prompt) vs prompt refined on 600 pilot cases
links.outcome: Match score for annotating trauma radiology reports (Llama3-8b)
links.quote: Prompt engineering improved the Match score for Llama3-8b from 77.8% (95% CI: 74.4%-81.1%) to 94.3% (95% CI: 92.5%-96.2%).
